items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: I used to like to play that all the time, Ted Lewis Jazz Band. And I used to play that record over and over

ctx.x: Very tinnish. Those records, you know, it was like the recording today and I used to like to play that all the time, Ted Lewis Jazz Band. And I used to play that record over and over on our graph and over. And just take two sticks, my brother, two sticks and beat against the wall with that front, if you understand. And just call myself falling behind, patting my foot on the floor. And that's why I just play that record over in the evening time around the house like that. Just play that over in Patchy's, Ted Lewis…
I was going to ask if you like heavy sticks or light sticks?
